tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /red mda' ba'i gsung thor bu las zhal gdams 'ga' zhig zur du bkol ba// ༈ /gang zhig legs gsung dam chos 'dul ba la/ /rab tu byung nas legs par mi sdom zhing / /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min 'da' byed pa'i/ /dge sbyong de dag 'jig rten chom rkun yin/ /'khyog por smra la gzhan dag brling por sems/ /ngag mi btsun pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /gya gyu'i sems dang de yi tshul spangs te/ /gsong por smra la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /'dzem med smra la gzhan dag spobs par sems/ /ngag mi sdom pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /mu cor smra ba smyon pa'i tshul spangs te/ /zhi ba'i tshul la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /phyi tshul 'chos la gzhan dag btsun por sems/ /g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /pha rol brid byed yon po'i tshul spangs te/ /des pa'i tshul la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /rang dga'i spyod pa gzhan dag drang por sems/ /dbang po mi sdom dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /bag dang mi ldan hral po'i tshul spangs te/ /bag yod tshul la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /bya byed mang ba gzhan dag grung por sems/ /rnam g.yeng 'dod pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /'du 'dzi bsrel ba khyim pa'i tshul spangs te/ /don nyung tshul la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /longs spyod 'byor ba gzhan dag dpal du sems/ /'dod zhen che ba dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /zang zing dang bcas grong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /chog shes tshul la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /grong dag 'grim pa gzhan dag gdul byar sems/ /rnyed bkur sgrub pa dge sbyong tshul min pas/ /khe spogs 'dod pa tshong pa'i tshul spangs te/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bos rtag tu bsten/ /zhes dang // ༈ /'jig rten 'dren pa lha mi'i ston pa yis/ /'dod la zhen pa khong khro'i rtsa bar bstan/ /'dod pa'i yon tan sdug bsngal bskyed pa ste/ /nad dang 'bras dang zug rngu'i rtsa ba yin/

/ji ltar mdze can g.yan pa phrugs pa dang / /tsha ba'i nad can sred pa'i chu dang ni/ /skom pas nyen pa lan tshwa'i chu 'thung bzhin/ /'dod pa bsten pas nam yang ngoms mi 'gyur/ /dug dang bcas pa'i kha zas g.yos legs dang / /spu gri'i so la chags pa'i sbrang rtsi dang / /shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs kyis rtswa zos bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mnog chung nyes pa mang / /glang chen dri la chags pa'i sbrang bu dang / /rngon pa'i glu dbyangs nyan pa'i ri dwags dang / /lcags kyu'i sha la chags pa'i nya bzhin du/ /'dod la rkam pa'i byis pa myur du brlag /ces gsungs so// ༈ /gang gi zhabs zung pad+mo'i ge sar rdul/ /tshangs dang lha dbang khyab 'jug la sogs pa/ /'jig rten dregs ldan gtsug gis gus bsten pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang du thos kyang tshul bzhin sgrub la g.yel/ /khrims brgya nod kyang nyes ltung dri ma can/ /dge sbyong bdag gi g.yar dam 'di rnams la/ /mkhyen ldan thugs rje'i lha khyod yud tsam dgongs/ /gang du gnas na snang shes 'phel 'gyur zhing / /rang rgyud rnyed bkur zhags pas 'ching byed la/ /gzhan rgyud phrag dog 'gran sems kyis gdung ba'i/ /gnas der skad cig tsam yang mi gnas so/ /deng nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ /gangs dang ri sul nags kyi khrod rnams su/ /bse ru lta bur rtag tu gnas byed cing / /grong dang 'khor mang dbus su gnas mi bgyi/ /chos brgyad rkyen gyis nam yang mi g.yo ba'i/ /sems la ji srid brtan pa ma thob par/ /gcig pur rang rgyud 'dul ba ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan don thabs kyis rang don nyams mi bgyi/ /chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed la sogs pa/ /rang nyid 'tsho ba'i yo byad ma gtogs pa/ /gser dang dbyig sogs lhag pa'i yo byad ni/ /rang gi don du til tsam mi bcang ngo / /gzhan gyi nyes pa nam yang mi gleng zhing / /don dang ldan zhing chos mthun ma gtogs pa/

/dmag dang chom rkun rgyal po'i gtam la sogs/ /'khrul ba'i bka' mchid nam yang mi bgyid do/ /chos kyi don du dka' spyad bsran bzod cing / /'jig rten blos btang rnam grol don du gnyer/ /'dod chung chog shes rang dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /rjes 'brang 'khor ni bzhi bas lhag mi bsten/ /gal te bdag gis g.yar dam 'di rnams dang / /'gal bar bgyis na rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs mgon gyis/ /khyi phag lug bong rnams dang bdag snyoms shig /ces gsungs// ༈ /gang la nyes pa rdul tsam mi mnga' zhing / /rmad byung yon tan dpal gyis rab brjid pas/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na g.yo/ /thub dbang lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ye nyon cig shes ldan grogs po dag /bstan pa'i nyin byed nub ri'i rtse la son/ /lus srog g.yo ba 'bab chu'i rgyun dang mtshungs/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis bag yod bsten par rigs/ /rin chen bdun ldan gling chen bzhi la dbang / /dpag med tshe gnas dge bcu'i dpal la spyod/ /phun tshogs mngon mtho'i bde la rol byed pa'i/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal dpal de'ang chu shing 'dra/ /lhun po'i spo la yun ring gnas bcas te/ /yongs 'du'i tshal du dga' bde'i dpal gyis rol/ /'chi med nye dpang tshogs kyis gus btud pa'i/ /'phrog byed mig stong ldan de'ang srid pa'i bran/ /lus sems zug rngu'i gdung ba ring du spangs/ /ting 'dzin bde bas bskal mang 'da' byed pa'i/ /'jig rten mes po gser gyi mngal ldan yang / /'chi med go 'phang las ring gyi nar 'khor/ /gang gis reg na rab brtan lhun po yang / /skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /me lce'i phreng ba lus la rab 'bar ba/ /dmyal ba'i zug rngu su yis brnag par nus/ /bltas pa tsam gyis klung chen rgyun skems shing / /ljon shing 'bras bu med par byed pa yi/ /ta la'i yang thog skam lta'i yi dwags gzugs/

/gang zhig mthong na 'jigs rung skyi yang g.ya'/ /blang dor rmongs pa'i gti mug smag rum 'thib/ /gcig la gcig za rdo rje'i me stag dang / /bkol spyod char rgyun lus la rtag 'bab pa'i/ /rnam mang dud 'gro'i dub pa su yis bzod/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs de ltar mnog chung zhing / /rab mang nyes pa'i tshogs dang ldan rig nas/ /rang gzhan srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /mang thos bdag ni dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /char 'dod byi 'us 'brug sgra thos pa ltar/ /dben pa'i gtam 'di kho bo'i snying la 'bab/ /thos pa'i don rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /ngang pa'i tshogs kyis pad+ma'i mtsho mthong ltar/ /bas mtha'i gnas la kho bo sems rab g.yo/ /dal 'byor lus la snying po blang ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /bung ba gzhon nus 'dab brgya'i tshal mthong ltar/ /kho bo'i yid ni dben pa'i ri la chags/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i ro de myong bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /dpyid dus bsil ba'i ma la ya'i rlung ltar/ /nags kyi sman ljon kho bo'i yid la 'bab/ /nyon mongs bdud kyi sde de gzhom bya'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /zhes so// ༈ /na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ gang la chags pas rtag tu sdug bsngal zhing / /me yi 'obs dang mi gtsang rdzab lta bu'i/ /'khor ba 'di la bde ba'i skabs med kyi/ /zhen log rgyun du sten cig sgrub pa dpal/ /nyon mongs nad chen sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam las gzhan med kyi/ /yengs med stong nyid sgoms shig sgrub pa dpal/ /las nyon dbang gis rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba ru/ /duḥkha rgyud mar myong ba'i 'gro ba 'di/ /thog med dus kyi drin can ma yin gyi/ /snying rje rgyun du sgoms shig sgrub pa dpal/

/mdor na/ 'khor ba la yid 'byung bas mnyam gzhag tu stong nyid bsgom zhing / rjes thob tu snying rje bsgom pa la nyams len gyi gtso bo mdzod/ ces pa dge slong gzhon nu blo gros kyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bka' drin mnyam med dpal ldan bla ma dang / /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ /mang du thos pa'i dge slong ku ma ras/ /dad ldan shes rab dpal la 'di skad 'doms/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen 'di/ /'jig par nges so nam 'jig nges pa med/ /skye bar nges so gar skye nges pa med/ /dal 'byor don yod mdzod cig shes rab dpal/ /'dod dang mi 'dod rnam smin 'bras bu ste/ /rang gis bsags pa'i dkar nag las 'bras rnams/ /myong bar nges so nam myong nges pa med/ /sdig spong dge la 'bad cig shes rab dpal/ /bsag dang srung dang brlag pa'i duḥkha can/ /ngal brgyas bsgrubs pa'i sgyu ma'i zas nor 'di/ /'dzad par nges so nam 'dzad nges pa med/ /longs spyod snying po longs shig shes rab dpal/ /phan byed bshes dang gnod byed dgra bo yang / /blo bur 'dus pa'i tshong 'dus 'gron po bzhin/ /'bral bar nges so nam 'bral nges pa med/ /chags sdang zhen pa skyungs shig shes rab dpal/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rang bsags dge sdig las 'bras ma gtogs pa/ /'khor dang nye du longs spyod rjes mi 'brang / /phyi ma'i lam rgyags sgrubs shig shes rab dpal/ /da lo 'di bya sang phod 'di byed ces/ /rtag rtag 'dra ba'i phyi tshis grabs shoms rnams/ /thog tu mi 'bab grog skam nya rgya 'dra/ /rtag tshis 'dod 'dun skyungs shig shes rab dpal/ /ces pa 'di 'bri khung thol gyi chen po shes rab dpal gyis chos kyi gdams pa gcig 'dod zhus pa la gdams pa'o// ༈ /'gyod med gdeng brod kyi mgur ma/ na mo gu ru/ gang la skyabs na slu med dkon mchog gsum/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du rtag bzhugs gsol/

/snang stong sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa/ /sems gnong med kyi glu skad 'di bzhin len/ /shul na 'phrengs pa'i zas nor lus pa med/ /gdong na mtsher ba'i las ngan bsags pa med/ /theg chen bslab pa'i bsam sbyor nyams pa med/ /sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur che thabs sgrub ma myong / /'dod yon sred pa'i rjes phyir 'brang ma myong / /don med bya bas tshe 'di yengs ma myong / /sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /cir snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i shes rab yod/ /'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i lhag bsam yod/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len yod/ /sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /thog mar gsung rab dgongs don tshul bzhin sbyangs/ /bar du blo gsal gdul bya'i tshogs la bshad/ /tha mar 'dris pa'i don la rtse gcig bsgoms/ /sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog las gces par bzung / /rigs dang mi rigs tshul bzhin rnam par phyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas dal 'byor don yod byas/ /sgyu ma'i lus sems bral yang 'gyod pa med/ /'gyod med gdeng brod kyi mgur ma 'di/ /gangs bu le'i mgul du blangs pa yin/ /mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams/ /mi nga bzhin byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pas rgyud sbyangs te/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i don rtogs shing / /rim gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje'i lam bsgoms pas/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru bdag gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 red mda' ba/ red mda' ba'i gsung thor bu las zhal gdams zur du bkol ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
